title: Radiofrequency ablation versus ethanol injection for early hepatocellular carcinoma: A randomized controlled trial
abstract: Objective. To compare percutaneous ethanol injection (PEI) and radiofrequency ablation (RFA) for early hepatocellular carcinoma in cirrhotic patients. Methods. Patients were randomized to RFA or PEI. Results. Complete response was higher with RFA. Overall survival was not significantly different.

title: A narrative review of coffee consumption and liver disease
abstract: This review summarizes observational literature on coffee and liver outcomes. No new trial was conducted.

title: Surgical outcomes after hepatectomy in a retrospective cohort
abstract: We retrospectively analyzed 120 patients undergoing hepatectomy at a single center. There was no randomization.
